note: Largest Salt Valley lake (1,800 acres), ~2.5 mi N of Malcolm. 338 pad sites in two main campgrounds, Middle Oak Creek (Area 4: paved 30/50-amp back-ins, non-electric pads and tent sites, two shower buildings, dump, boat ramp) and South Shore (Area 1: 30/50-amp and 11 full-hookup sites, two coin-op shower buildings, two dumps), plus primitive camping in other use areas. Some sites reservable up to 180 days out, the rest FCFS. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: NGPC/ReserveAmerica park page and all 179 reservable sites read. Park-wide: 338 pads, 30/50A, 12 full-hookup sites (South Shore), showers, 4 dumps, pull-throughs, rigs to 100 ft; reservable on ReserveAmerica 180 days out, rest FCFS. Platform corrected operator -> reserveamerica. Stored pin is not on a campground (a peninsula use area by a marina ~2.5 km NE of Middle Oak). The entry overlaps 13957 (South Shore); suggest it becomes Middle Oak, re-pinned, and down to lakeview.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 40.9800,-96.8590 sits on a picnic/day-use peninsula beside a marina and boat ramp (imagery: one cul-de-sac, shelters, breakwaters), not on any RA campground loop. Middle Oak's 100 RA sites centre at 40.97178,-96.88748 (2.56 km SW); South Shore's 78 at 40.95948,-96.87214 (2.54 km S, 223 m from 13957's pin). Suggest re-pinning to Middle Oak 40.97178,-96.88748 (Google's 'Middle Oak Creek Campground' point is 40.97082,-96.88650, ~135 m off).

OVERLAP / SCOPE: this park-wide entry duplicates 13957 'Branched Oak SRA - Southshore Campground'. Middle Oak Creek (Area 4) has no entry of its own. Suggest 2677 be renamed 'Branched Oak State Recreation Area - Middle Oak Creek Campground' and re-pinned there. If so, Middle Oak alone is 100 RA back-ins (68 at 30A, 32 at 50A), no water or sewer hookups, max 55 ft and no pull-throughs: hookups.water/sewer, sites.pull_through and max_rig_ft 100 then belong to 13957, and the count 338 is park-wide. Homestead Campground (Area 2) has a single RA site (119, at 40.95890,-96.87445, 59 m from 13957's pin), so it is covered by 13957. Not a split: the two campgrounds already have, or would have, one entry each.

WATER: stored lakefront is earned only by South Shore (RA tags 77 of 78 sites 'Shoreline site Y / Lakefront', 50-400 ft from shore), which is 13957. For Middle Oak suggest lakefront -> lakeview. RA tags 8 Middle Oak sites (042-048, 057) Lakefront, but its own Distance from Shoreline gives 600-700 ft for 042-048 and 100 ft for 057. Imagery at 057 (40.97014,-96.88444): the pad comes off the campground's own paved loop/cul-de-sac, which lies between it and the water; the shore is ~80 m S across open grass with scattered shrubs. That is the campground loop road plus a set-back apron, so a view at best. Front row 051-057 = 100-250 ft. Official photos of 052/056/057 face the pads and show no water. If 2677 stays park-wide, lakefront holds through South Shore, but that duplicates 13957.
